name: optionsahoy
description: Deterministic equity-compensation tax tools: ISO/AMT exercise scheduling, NSO, RSU, QSBS, concentration risk, hedging, and equity funding plans.
long_description:
Seven deterministic calculators for US equity-compensation planning, computed against the full federal tax code plus all 50 states and DC.

- **amt_iso_optimize** — multi-year ISO exercise schedule that minimizes AMT, with credit recovery
- **nso_calculate** — NSO exercise tax + sell-vs-hold comparison
- **rsu_sell_vs_hold** — RSU vest decision with the 12-month LTCG cliff
- **concentration_analyze** — single-stock concentration risk + sell-down vs hold vs hedge
- **protective_put_price** — protective put / zero-cost collar pricing (Black-Scholes)
- **qsbs_check** — Section 1202 QSBS qualification (eight statutory tests, OBBBA 2026)
- **equity_funding_plan** — multi-year sell schedule to hit a target after-tax amount by a date

Every response is the best schedule across the candidate space, computed deterministically and validated against brute-force ground truth on tractable cases. A published 5-LLM benchmark on the same multi-year ISO problem found every trial overshot the achievable after-tax outcome by 2-20x — the math is verifiable; in-context reasoning isn't.

No account, no API key, no PII retention. Same engine as the free calculators at optionsahoy.com/tools.
